mapper.select: SELECT id, today_task_id, patient_id, scheduled_time, type, status, retry_count, last_retry_time, notification_content, failure_reason, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, deleted, tenant_id FROM reminder_tasks WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY scheduled_time ASC
